name: net.donky.core.messaging.rich.logic.database.RichMsgContentProvider
description: Android creates this Donky Rich Messaging provider during app startup, where it initializes local message storage. Donky also uses it to read, add, update, and remove rich-message records.
disableEffect: Blocking it can leave Donky’s rich-message storage uninitialized, preventing rich messages and the inbox from loading.
